charset.description: The input character set specified to unaccent (e.g., ISO-8859-1, UTF-8). Corresponds to the 'charset' positional argument.

debug_low.description: Print human readable information about the unaccentuation process. Corresponds to --debug_low.

debug_high.description: Print very detailed information about the unaccentuation process. Corresponds to --debug_high.

expected_output.description: The expected output string to validate against. If provided, unaccent exits with error if the transformed output does not match. Corresponds to the 'expected' argument.
